summary: Final validation testing for Oficina Reis - Iteration 8. All 5 features tested and working correctly: Dashboard Cliente stats, Minhas OS with timeline, /api/cliente/minhas-os endpoint, Services filtered by funcionário specialties, Photo upload (Antes/Depois)

minor.issue: Returns 0 for servicos_disponiveis even though /api/servicos-funcionario returns 4 disponivel services. Dashboard stats calculation may have inconsistent filtering logic.

Backend: /api/cliente/minhas-os includes all required fields (status, servicos, pecas, fotos, etc)
Backend: /api/servicos-funcionario filters by especialidades (Virabrequim, Bloco only)
Frontend: Dashboard Cliente shows 4 stat cards (Total OS, Em Processo, Em Trânsito, Entregues)
Frontend: Minhas OS page loads with timeline (Recebido, Em Processo, Pronto, Enviando, Entregue)
Frontend: OS #003 displayed in Minhas OS with expandable details
Frontend: Expanded OS shows Serviços, Peças, Fotos (Antes/Depois), and Resumo Financeiro
Frontend: Serviços page shows only Virabrequim and Bloco sectors
Frontend: Iniciar button works - service status changes to 'Em Andamento'
Frontend: After Iniciar, Antes/Depois/Concluir buttons appear
Frontend: Foto Antes modal opens with correct service details
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard cliente stats correctly calculated from /api/cliente/minhas-os response
Timeline component shows progress visually with checkmarks and pulsing animation
Services filtering by especialidades works correctly - funcionario only sees Virabrequim and Bloco
Photo upload modal includes notification text: 'O cliente e o ADM serão notificados'
Minor: Dashboard funcionario stats returns 0 while servicos-funcionario API returns actual data - inconsistent counting logic
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 8 features verified: 1) Dashboard Cliente shows stats (Total OS=1, Em Processo=1, Em Trânsito=0, Entregues=0) for cliente@teste.com. 2) Minhas OS page displays OS #003 with timeline and expandable details including Serviços, Peças, Fotos, and Resumo Financeiro. 3) /api/cliente/minhas-os correctly gets cliente_id from users table (via user.cliente_id or by email lookup in clientes). 4) Funcionario sees only Virabrequim and Bloco services due to especialidades filtering. 5) Photo upload modal works with Antes/Depois buttons.
